historical_references.reference: Baruni was a legendary king of the Vatsa dynasty in ancient India, who ruled around the 6th century BCE. He is best known for his political alliances and his role in the life of the Buddhist monk Mahavira. According to Jain texts, King Baruni was the first lay follower of Mahavira, and it was during his reign that Mahavira attained Kevala Jnana, or perfect knowledge.
